projects.name: Project - Eurotech
projects.shortDesc: Enterprise technology solution for business optimization
projects.description: Eurotech is a sports and entertainment platform focused on delivering an engaging and accessible user experience. I used this project to apply my newly acquired knowledge of the Jekyll framework while exploring ways to improve the existing website structure. The project provided an opportunity to work with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript while gaining practical experience in maintaining and optimizing an existing web application.
projects.challenge: The main challenge was understanding the existing codebase and identifying opportunities to simplify its structure and improve maintainability. During the investigation, I discovered code that was either unused or not functioning as intended. I focused on restructuring the implementation, removing unnecessary code, and creating a lighter solution that could support dynamic content while improving the overall browsing experience.
projects.results: The project resulted in a cleaner and more streamlined implementation, with unnecessary code removed and the overall structure simplified. These changes provided a better foundation for maintaining the website and aimed to improve loading performance and interaction smoothness. The experience also strengthened my ability to analyze existing codebases and identify practical optimization opportunities.

projects.name: SkillBridge
projects.shortDesc: Freelancer marketplace connecting talented professionals with clients
projects.description: SkillBridge is a full-stack freelancer marketplace designed to connect professionals with clients through a centralized platform for collaboration and opportunity discovery. Built with the MERN stack, the application supports user registration, communication, opportunity listings, and content publishing. The project evolved from a simple landing page into a multi-page platform featuring a custom content management system for administrative tasks.
projects.techstack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JWT, Github
projects.challenge: The primary challenge was evolving the application into a cohesive platform with multiple user roles, interconnected features, and centralized content management. As the scope expanded, maintaining a clear application structure and reliable data flow became increasingly important. I developed the platform incrementally, integrating user-facing functionality with administrative tools while addressing the additional complexity introduced by each new feature.
projects.results: The project grew into a multi-page marketplace with user accounts, communication features, opportunity listings, and administrative content management. The custom CMS allows administrators to manage platform content and users, while publishing functionality supports the creation of blog posts. SkillBridge demonstrates my ability to develop a full-stack application that brings multiple interconnected features together in a single platform.

projects.name: Manaus-Hotel
projects.shortDesc: Hotel booking and management system for Manaus hospitality
projects.description: Manaus-Hotel is a hotel booking and management application concept developed to explore web solutions for the hospitality industry. Built with React, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS, the project focused on recreating an existing application concept using a different technology stack and implementation approach. It provided an opportunity to apply React fundamentals to a practical project while exploring interface design and the structure of a hospitality-focused application.
projects.techstack: React, CSS, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, HTML, Github
projects.challenge: The main challenge was translating an existing application concept into a functional frontend using React and Tailwind CSS. I focused on organizing the interface into reusable components, structuring the application effectively, and applying responsive styling techniques. The project also required me to think through implementation decisions and find suitable solutions for the design and functionality I wanted to recreate.
projects.results: The project resulted in a functional frontend implementation that brought the hotel application concept to life using React and Tailwind CSS. It strengthened my understanding of component-based development, styling techniques, and interface design. The experience also helped establish a stronger foundation for building more complex React applications with an emphasis on usability and visual consistency.

projects.name: TMDB
projects.shortDesc: Movie database application with advanced search and filtering
projects.description: TMDB is a movie discovery application built with React and the TMDB API. The project combines external movie data with a custom user interface to create an interactive browsing experience. It also introduced browser local storage as a way to retain selected movie information, allowing me to explore client-side data persistence alongside API integration and dynamic content rendering.
projects.techstack: React, CSS, JavaScript, HTML, TMDB API, Github
projects.challenge: The main challenge was learning how to retrieve, interpret, and display data from an external API using its documentation. I needed to understand how application data could be obtained from a remote service and integrated into my own interface. I expanded the project further by experimenting with local storage, exploring how data could persist between visits without requiring a dedicated backend database.
projects.results: The project brought together external API integration, dynamic movie content, and browser-based data persistence in a React application. It strengthened my understanding of asynchronous data retrieval, application data flow, and interactive interface development. The experience also provided a practical foundation for working with third-party services and managing client-side state in future projects.

projects.name: WalletPatrol
projects.shortDesc: Personal finance management and expense tracking application
projects.description: WalletPatrol is a personal finance tracking application inspired by the idea of building a custom alternative to existing expense management tools. What began as a simple expense tracker evolved into an application incorporating user authentication and database storage. Built with React and MongoDB, the project explores how personal financial records can be managed through a dedicated interface with persistent data and authenticated access.
projects.techstack: React, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MongoDB, BrowserRouter, ProtectedRoutes, Github
projects.challenge: The main challenge was expanding a basic expense tracker into an application with user accounts and persistent financial data. This required moving beyond client-side functionality to introduce authentication, database integration, and protected application routes. I also had to consider how financial records should be associated with individual users and how access to personal information should be controlled.
projects.results: The project evolved from a simple tracking interface into a more complete application incorporating authentication and database-backed data management. It provided practical experience in connecting a React frontend to a database, structuring persistent records, and restricting access through protected routes. WalletPatrol also gave me a stronger understanding of the considerations involved in building applications that handle personal information.

projects.name: VCS-Baigiamasis
projects.shortDesc: Version control system thesis project with collaborative features
projects.description: VCS-Baigiamasis is a team-developed full-stack tool rental platform created as a final project. Built with the MERN stack, the application was designed to help customers find and rent tools while supporting the management of users, tool listings, rental records, and payment information. As my first MERN project developed collaboratively, it also gave me the opportunity to coordinate a team of seven people, organize development tasks, and help bring multiple application components together.
projects.techstack: React, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MongoDB, Express, Node.js, BrowserRouter, ProtectedRoutes, Tailwind CSS, Github
projects.challenge: The challenge extended beyond application development to coordinating a seven-person team and integrating work across multiple contributors. I was responsible for organizing tasks, understanding team members' strengths, and helping resolve blockers when progress slowed. On the technical side, the platform required a structured data model for users, tools, rental history, and payment records, alongside rental scheduling logic designed to prevent overlapping bookings. Balancing these technical requirements with team coordination made this the most demanding project I had undertaken at the time.
projects.results: The team established a working foundation that met the project's initial requirements within the first week, allowing development to continue with additional features and refinements. The project brought together frontend development, backend services, database design, and collaborative workflows in a single application. It also strengthened my experience in task delegation, technical problem-solving, team coordination, and managing the complexity of a full-stack project. The resulting platform was designed around the core workflows required for a tool rental service.

projects.name: KP Website
projects.shortDesc: Modern corporate website for business presence and lead generation
projects.description: A basic website used to sharpen and learn new features and techniques in web development. Its a pure static website that used basics of a modern web development stack including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
projects.challenge: The main challenge was creating a maintainable website structure while achieving a consistent visual design across different screen sizes. I focused on organizing the HTML, writing reusable and understandable CSS rules, and exploring more advanced layout techniques. The goal was to balance visual presentation with responsive behavior and keep the implementation straightforward to maintain.
projects.results: The project resulted in a static website built around core web technologies, with an emphasis on responsive layout and visual consistency. It gave me additional practice in structuring HTML, organizing CSS, and implementing frontend behavior with JavaScript. These fundamentals continue to inform how I approach layout, styling, and maintainability in more complex applications.

projects.name: Portfolio v0.9
projects.shortDesc: Previous portfolio version showcasing earlier design evolution
projects.description: Portfolio v0.9 is an earlier version of my personal portfolio, created to present my projects, skills, and development experience in a single place. Built with Jekyll, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and YAML, it reflects an earlier stage of my frontend development journey. The project provided a foundation for experimenting with website structure, visual presentation, and content organization while developing my personal brand.
projects.techstack: HTML, Jekyll, CSS, JavaScript, Skeleton, YAML, Github
projects.challenge: The main challenge was creating a portfolio that presented my work clearly while working within the technologies and experience I had at the time. I needed to organize project information, establish a consistent visual identity, and build a layout that made the content accessible to visitors. The project also required balancing design decisions with the practical limitations of my existing technical knowledge.
projects.results: The project produced a functional portfolio that brought my work and skills together in a dedicated website. It established an initial approach to presenting projects and developing a personal online presence. The experience also provided a reference point for evaluating earlier design decisions and identifying opportunities to improve the structure, flexibility, and presentation of subsequent portfolio versions.

projects.name: Personal Portfolio
projects.shortDesc: Current React-based portfolio with modern architecture and design
projects.description: This is my current personal portfolio, developed with React to showcase my projects, technical skills, and progression as a developer. Building on the concept of my previous portfolio, this version uses a component-based architecture and a more structured approach to organizing content. The website combines responsive layouts, project galleries, and reusable interface elements to present my work through a consistent visual experience.
projects.challenge: The main challenge was creating a portfolio that felt modern and distinctive without making the design unnecessarily complex. I wanted to retain the visual direction of my previous work while improving the underlying structure through React components and reusable content. This required balancing layout, visual hierarchy, responsiveness, and maintainability while refining smaller design details that contribute to the overall experience.
projects.results: The result is a React-based portfolio that brings my projects and skills together in a consistent, responsive interface. The component-based structure provides a foundation for organizing and updating content, while the project gallery gives visitors a dedicated view of my work. Developing this version also allowed me to reflect on my progress as a developer and demonstrate the practical frontend skills I have built through successive projects.
